The odds ratio for comfort is 0.266, meaning that for every unit increase in the comfort aspect, the odds of a customer not recommending the item decrease by a factor of 0.266. This effect is observed in 29.42% of the reviews mentioning comfort.

The odds ratio for the aspect "length" is 1.2836, meaning that for every unit increase in the mention of length, the odds of a customer not recommending the item increase by a factor of 1.2836. This effect is statistically significant with a 95% confidence interval of 1.0948 to 1.5049.
